v1.6.5 (code 47): avatar no longer disappears — /auth/login, /auth/refresh and /auth/me now read photo_url straight from the DB (the cached user row could be stale) and the app keeps its phone-local copy as a fallback; the password call also sends the token in the body.

v1.6.4 (code 46): profile password/photo calls now use a direct transport with no 401-refresh wrapper, so the toast shows the TRUE status (e.g. 401 Session expired — log out and sign in again, or the real server detail) instead of a generic network error raised by the refresh path.

v1.6.3 (code 45): profile picture now refreshes — the uploaded file keeps the same name so the WebView showed the old image; the avatar URL is version-stamped (cache-bust) and the new photo shows immediately. Password change now reports the REAL error (wrong current password / min 6 chars) instead of hiding it behind the legacy-route network error, and the legacy /auth route is only retried on a network failure.

v1.6.2 (code 44): profile password + photo upload now call the normal /api/profile/* endpoints with JSON + Authorization (the same transport every other working call uses) with the /auth/* absolute URL as a fallback; the earlier text/plain attempt was rejected by our own content-type middleware (415), so it is no longer the primary path.

v1.6.1 (code 43): profile password change and photo upload now use preflight-free endpoints (/api/profile/password via text/plain body, /api/profile/photo via multipart with the token in the form) because the phone was rejecting the preflighted /auth/* POSTs with a network error; the old routes remain as a fallback.

v1.6.0 (code 42): profile picture fixes — the avatar (server photo or a phone-local copy) shows on Home, the Menu profile card and the Me screen; a failed upload keeps the picture on the phone with the reason in the toast; the Profile section gained a Test connection row reporting whether the app can reach the API; the More footer prints the real build (42).

v1.5.9 (code 41): diagnostics + fixes — the More footer now shows the REAL build number (it was hardcoded 'build 34'); the Home header got a gear icon that opens the profile (/me); and both Change password and Profile picture now retry once against the explicit https://ps-vibe.com origin when the first attempt fails at the network layer, reporting the exact failure in the toast.

v1.5.8 (code 40): editable profile — Me screen gains a Profile section (upload a profile picture via /auth/profile/photo, change password via /auth/change-password) with the avatar shown in the profile card, and the Log out button now has breathing room (18px spacer + margin) in both the Me screen and the Menu.

v1.5.7 (code 39): menu tile grid polish — 4 columns with real card backgrounds/borders and 2-line clamped labels so tiles line up evenly, tighter spacing between categories, and empty categories are never rendered (the odd leftover tile no longer leaves a big void).

v1.5.6 (code 38): the Menu is now a compact tile grid grouped by category (like the Home quick actions) instead of long row lists — far less scrolling; the owner lock marker and any badge are kept on the tiles.

v1.5.5 (code 37): Timeline shows confirmed bookings on any picked day — the visibility test was comparing every booking against the CURRENT clock, so confirmed bookings on Tomorrow (or another date) were treated as already finished and hidden; only today is time-filtered now.

v1.5.4 (code 36): admin = owner in the menu too — the Owner-only chip/lock label is now role-aware (effTag) so an admin account no longer sees 'Owner only' or a greyed row on OPEX / Salary advance / Account Balances, while an explicit staff role still gets the lock; Salary advance wording is now 'Owner / admin managed'.

v1.5.3 (code 35): admin = owner permissions — OPEX is no longer a dead placeholder: the menu row opens a real owner/admin screen (this month's expenses + total + Add expense) and POST /dashboard/opex is now admin/owner-only server-side; staff keep the locked card.

v1.5.2 (code 34): diagnostics + the v1.5.1 role fix — the More menu now prints the running build and the account role (so a screenshot identifies the installed version), and the Salary locked card shows the API status (e.g. 403 owner-only) when it cannot load.

v1.5.1 (code 33): fixes the v1.5.0 over-block — the admin account could not open Salary because api.js defaults an absent role to 'staff' and the client gate trusted it. Owner-only rows are visible again for everyone (the guard only blocks an explicitly staff/cashier/manager role) and the Salary screen always queries the API, where the admin-only 403 is the real gate (staff still get the locked card).

v1.5.0 (code 32): salary advance is owner-only — the owner-only menu guard now blocks BEFORE navigation (it used to open the Salary screen anyway), owner-only rows are hidden from non-admin staff menus, and the Salary screen itself is role-gated on the client so the staff role only sees a locked card and never calls the endpoint (the API was already admin-only/403).

v1.4.9 (code 31): brand polish — Home and the login screen now show the real PS VIBE logo artwork (with the wordmark, gold on the dark theme); the launcher icon is the text-free symbol (navy tile + gold mark, adaptive foreground/background updated); app name is now PS VIBE.

v1.4.8 (code 30): removed the redundant All drafts button and the in-form drafts popup from New Sale now that drafts have their own Sales tab and the Draft vouchers screen; Save as draft stays and the hint points at Sales -> Drafts tab.

v1.4.7 (code 29): Save as draft now clears the form (fresh voucher no, empty member/console/game/food/splits/promo) so the next sale starts clean; and Draft vouchers got their own tab in the Sales screen right next to Today (list + Restore & finish + delete).

v1.4.6 (code 28): Stock In item picker now lists EVERY inventory item (API /fetch_food_menu?all=1) — out-of-stock items such as လျှာမီးတောက် were hidden because the menu endpoint only returned quantity>0 items in a fixed category list; the sales food menu is unchanged.

v1.4.5 (code 27): Guest is pinned to the top of the member picker; the Stock In item picker now lists the WHOLE food menu (not just items already in stock) grouped by food category (then existing stock items, then New Item) using the compact searchable picker with category headers.

v1.4.4 (code 26): Draft vouchers get their own screen — reachable from More → Draft vouchers; lists every parked sale (label, saved time, game/mins/payment/food summary) with the total parked value, Delete per entry, Delete all, and Restore & finish which loads the draft into New Sale. The draft is removed automatically once that sale is saved.

v1.4.3 (code 25): New Sale — Save as draft. The whole sale (member, console, game, mins, food cart, split payments, discount, promo/coupon state) is snapshotted to the device, so a voucher can be parked when the money is only settled later; Drafts (N) opens the list to Restore or Delete, and restoring puts everything back so Save Sale can finish it. Drafts never touch the server.

v1.4.2 (code 24): speed — the read path now caches. apiCached upgraded to stale-while-revalidate with a localStorage-persisted store (instant first paint after an app restart) and any successful write invalidates the cache. 101 read call sites switched from PSV.api to PSV.apiCached (slow-changing lists cache 2-10 min, the rest 15 s); realtime/auth endpoints stay uncached.

v1.4.1 (code 23): Stock in / Sales dropdowns — the big wheel pickers (van-picker with tall rows, no search) are replaced by the compact searchable PSVPicker sheet: item picker in Stock In, payment pickers in Stock In / New Sale / Top-up and the game picker in New Sale. Tap a row to select, search box auto-appears for long lists.

v1.4.0 (code 22): member-card voucher — for wallet plays the receipt now shows the GAME MINUTES and 'Game amount: 0 Ks (card)' instead of the game price, plus a MEMBER BALANCE breakdown (before / deducted / after) parsed from the sale notes; Paid shows 'Member card (mins)' and the cash TOTAL stays the net amount.

v1.3.9 (code 21): FIX — the logo did not print because the blank-line trimmer treated the image line (which has no text) as a blank line and dropped it; image lines now count as content. The PS VIBE logo (with the wordmark, 632x168 black on white) prints centred at 340 dots at the top of the voucher.

v1.3.8 (code 20): the receipt header now prints the REAL PS VIBE logo (the artwork that includes the wordmark) as an image — bundled at assets/print/psvibe-logo.png (auto-cropped, black on white, 632x168), drawn centred at the top of the voucher. The native renderer gained image-line support ({img, size, align}) for asset:/data: sources, with a text fallback for builds that cannot render images.

v1.3.7 (code 19): tighter receipt per owner 15:19 — leading/trailing empty voucher lines are dropped, top/bottom padding 10 -> 6 dots, and the pre-cut feed reduced 6 -> 4 LF (~15mm) because the bottom still had too much blank paper.

v1.3.6 (code 18): fixes v1.3.5 which shipped WITHOUT the Lexend font (the download redirected and left a 0-byte file) — the bundled Lexend variable TTF is now really inside the APK, English/number lines print in Lexend, Myanmar lines keep Noto Sans Myanmar; font dots -2px (title 52 / wide 38 / body 30); receipt top/bottom padding reduced to 10 dots; pre-cut feed 6 LF.

v1.3.5 (code 17): print polish per owner 15:15 — font dots another -2px (title 52 / wide 38 / body 30), English lines now print in the bundled Lexend font (Myanmar lines keep Noto Sans Myanmar), and the receipt's top/bottom padding reduced to 10 dots (side margin unchanged so edges stay clean).

v1.3.4 (code 16): print fine-tuning after the raw ESC/POS path was confirmed good at 80mm — voucher dot metrics reduced ~10% (title 54 / wide 40 / body 32) because the owner found them a little too big, and the pre-cut feed cut from 12 LF to 6 LF (~22mm) because the auto-cut left too much blank paper below the receipt.

v1.3.3 (code 15): NEW raw ESC/POS voucher path (printVoucherRaw) — renders at exactly 576 dots (80mm) in-app and writes GS v 0 raster bands straight to the printer stream, so the DantSu library cannot scale or centre the receipt (root cause of the 384-dot / 48mm tiny prints). No paper-profile dependency, 12-line feed + auto-cut, toast reports 576 dots (80mm).

v1.3.2 (code 14): vouchers are PINNED to 80mm/576 dots on both the app side (printVoucherNative forces the 80mm profile) and the web side (setPaperWidth(80) + 576px raster canvas) so a stale 58mm profile can never shrink the receipt again (root cause of 'receipt too small / not 80mm'); native text metrics raised to title 60 / wide 44 / body 36 dots; print toast now reports the real dot width

v1.3.1: self-contained APK (UI bundled) + native voucher print pinned to 80mm/576-dot with enlarged metrics (title 56 / wide 40 / body 32), margin 26 + word wrap, 12-line feed + auto-cut; API calls from the bundled UI now use the public origin with CORS allowlisted for the Capacitor origins

Self-contained UI bundled in the APK (no remote web app) + native in-app voucher print (Android Canvas, Myanmar-safe). Receipt pinned to 80mm/576-dot; enlarged metrics body 32 / wide 40 / title 56, line spacing size+12. versionCode 12 / 1.3.0
Voucher size fix: raster lines now map to the printer's native dot sizes (48/32/24) instead of 1:1 pixels, so Burmese vouchers print at the same size as the text path

Timeline: confirmed upcoming visible until window end + banner-aware one-screen fit; print: Burmese rendered as raster (no more ??), cost per item (@unit) on vouchers, footer feed 12 lines so the cutter no longer chops it
Timeline: confirmed upcoming bookings stay visible until the window ends (owner fix 11:43) + food itemised on vouchers + member wallet deduct detail + စမှတ် (no timer) start option
Timeline spec v2 (Active+confirmed upcoming, forfeit 1h, 1-screen fit)

Printer quality v2: auto-cut + crisp text + 58/80mm + opt. density

In-app self-update: old app detects new version (start/resume/6h/refresh), 'Update now' downloads the APK inside the app with a progress bar, then opens the Android installer (falls back to browser download on old builds). Requires Android 'install unknown apps' permission.

Bookings ops (approve/reject/check-in/cancel, deposit verify+redeem), promo/coupon, sessions move/swap, inventory stock-out/check/alerts, report+balances, attendance check-out, gift card, rank/bonus, notification centre, 80mm printing. English UI.
